meta.name: muapi-music-video
meta.description: Build a short music video from a song theme — N keyframes, animate each, generate matching music.

copy.tagline: 根据歌曲主题自动生成音乐短片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想快速把歌曲主题变成带动画和配乐的短视频
copy.tagline_en: Generate a short music video from a song theme automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to quickly turn a song theme into a short video with animation and music

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude 会根据你提供的歌曲主题，自动生成一组关键帧画面、对应的动画片段和一段匹配的音乐，最终组合成一部短音乐视频。
howto.when: 当你提到“音乐视频”、“MV”、“视频故事”或“歌曲可视化”等关键词，并给出歌曲主题时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个关于“孤独机器人找到朋友”的音乐视频。
say.note: Claude 会询问场景数、音乐风格等细节，然后生成视频。

say.text: 用赛博朋克风格，3个场景，生成一首音乐视频。
say.note: 指定了视觉风格和场景数，Claude 会按此生成。

howto.what_en: Claude generates keyframes, animations, and matching music from a song theme, then assembles them into a short music video.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "music video", "MV", "video story", or "song visualization" and provide a theme.

say_en.text: Make a music video about a lonely robot finding a friend.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for details like scene count and music style, then generate.

say_en.text: Create a cyberpunk MV with 3 scenes.
say_en.note: Specifies visual style and scene count; Claude will follow.
